programs.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programs.desc: It's Refugee Week on The Cook Up. Fashion designer Anjilla Seddeqi and Refugee Council Ambassador Lizzy Kuoth join Adam to share the food that is always on their tables.

programs.title: Cheese Slices
programs.desc: Squeaky, salty haloumi is one of the world's best-loved grilled cheeses. However most of it is now mass produced using cows milk. Will heads to the island of Cyprus to see how it's traditionally made.

programs.title: Flat Out Food
programs.desc: Jenn visits an organic grain farmer, a baker, and a whiskey maker to learn about the various uses of wheat.

programs.title: Destination Flavour Down Under
programs.desc: During a day out on the magnificent waters of Nitmiluk Gorge, Adam nets a barramundi, which he cooks up at a breathtaking spot in front of Edith Falls.

programs.title: Great Chocolate Showdown
programs.desc: With immunity off the table, the top six bakers pair up to build a magnificent meringue tower.

programs.title: Please Eat Slowly Bitesize
programs.desc: Learn how to make mouth-watering Yee Sang. Victor has a few tricks for slicing the perfect julienne at home, as well as some presentation tips to make your salad a showstopper.

programs.title: On Country Kitchen
programs.desc: Mark and Derek visit a kitchen garden, help out at a goat dairy, and eat abalone burgers on the beach. Atop Cambewarra mountain, the boys hear the story of the black cockatoo.

programs.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programs.desc: Rachael shows us how to make a beautiful, white, quick cooking ragu sauce that she'll serve over ribbony pappardelle pasta cooked al dente style.

programs.title: My Market Kitchen
programs.desc: Matt explores Noosa Farmers Market with a vegan recipe, silken tofu with chilli and spring onion. Mike hits the road with Mann About Town, David Mann, whipping up pork cutlets and nashi pear.

programs.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programs.desc: Life can be hard, so let Lidia's simple recipes provide some relief & inspiration to feel healthy.

programs.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programs.sub_title: The Nectar Of The Mayan Gods
programs.desc: Pati is in the magic town of Mani to learn about something sacred to the Mayans: bees and honey. She makes sweet lime roasted chicken with broccolini.

programs.title: Silvia's Italian Masterclass
programs.desc: A celebration of the Italian Sunday tradition, where Nonna's table brings together family, tradition, and irresistible flavours from slow-cooked sugo to crispy festive sweets.
